technology_name: Flexible Elastomer Composite for Organic Light Emitting Diodes
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Conventional transparent conducting oxides are highly brittle, prone to stress cracking under bending, and require expensive high-vacuum processing layers.
description: Development of an organic light-emitting system utilizing a fully elastic, flexible polymer/conducting oxide composite acting as a stable hole-injection framework that emits a consistent pale green profile under 4-6 V bias conditions.
applications: Foldable smartphone displays, flexible wearable technology screens, rollable organic television displays, and curved biometric instrument interfaces.
